topic: Augment Verification Bottleneck Guide 2026: Automating AI Code Review After Agents Ship Code

angles: The verification bottleneck: AI agents ship code faster than humans can review it — the constraint has moved from writing to verification
Spec-first review paradigm: review intent and plan, not just the diff — catch architectural mistakes before they're coded
Independent auditor model (Greptile's SOX analogy): code review must be independent from code generation to maintain objectivity
Layered verification stack: combine AI review + static analysis + type checking + adversarial test agents + human oversight
Cost economics: AI review at $1.50/PR vs $75-150/hr human review — the ROI case for automation
The human-in-the-loop sweet spot: AI handles first-pass review, humans focus on architectural decisions and edge cases
Model selection matters: GPT-5.2 > Sonnet for async code review (correctness over latency) — different models for different SDLC stages
PR quality crisis: AI-generated PRs are larger, harder to understand, and have lower acceptance rates — new review workflows needed
